_source.title: 获取连接的图元
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口可以获取到与焊盘直接接触的图元
_source.params.onlyCentreConnection: 是否仅中心连接，如若为 `true` 则仅获取中心连接的图元（直线、圆弧线、过孔），如若为 `false` 则获取所有接触的图元

title: Get connected primitives
remarks.text.0: This API can get the primitives that are in direct contact with the pad
params.onlyCentreConnection: Whether to only use center connection. If it is `true`, only center-connected primitives (lines, arc lines, vias) are obtained; if it is `false`, all contacting primitives are obtained
